The '''Imperial Palace''' was a towering palace built of [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Marble/Legends|marble]] that was located in the center of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Livien Magnus]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]]. In front of the Palace stood a massive statue of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]].<ref name="OAA1" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Palace was the headquarters for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] presence on Ord Radama. It was both the [[Planetary Governor/Legends|Planetary Governor's]] seat and the location of the Empire's barracks.<ref name="OAA1" />
